item.title: ०५७ रामेण दुर्निमित्तदर्शनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Rama meets Lakshmana while returning to hermitage after killing the deer demon Maareecha. He also confronts some ill omens and worries why Lakshmana left Seetha alone and came to him, sad facedly.

भागसूचना

श्रीरामका लौटना, मार्गमें अपशकुन देखकर चिन्तित होना तथा लक्ष्मणसे मिलनेपर उन्हें उलाहना दे सीतापर सङ्कट आनेकी आशङ्का करना

सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Turning back swiftly after slaying the shape-shifting Mārīca, Rāma hears a jackal howling behind him and fears that Mārīca’s counterfeit cry will draw Lakṣmaṇa away from Sītā.

item.title: ०५८ रामशोकः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Rama is anguished for Seetha’s aloneness and it is expressed in his chastening Lakshmana. Rama asks him as to why he left Seetha unguarded in the lonely forest. Rama rushes rapidly to hermitage thinking and talking that rapidly to Lakshmana about Seetha, and on arriving he finds vacuity in hermitage and then he is thrown in throes of despair.

भागसूचना
  1. मार्गमें अनेक प्रकारकी आशङ्का करते हुए लक्ष्मणसहित श्रीरामका आश्रममें आना और वहाँ सीताको न पाकर व्यथित होना

item.title: ०५९ लक्ष्मणनिन्दा
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Rama reprimands Lakshmana for coming without Seetha. Lakshmana explains that he had to leave her owing to her anguished and angrily words and even by her rash remarks of Lakshmana. Even then, Rama is unhappy of Lakshmana’s action in leaving her alone.

The content of this chapter is to amplify what that has been said in the previous chapter. This dialogue between Rama and Lakshmana may be deemed to have happened before their approaching hermitage, as in the last few verses of last chapter, and on their pathway to their hermitage.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणकी बातचीत

item.title: ०६० राम-लक्ष्मणयोः पर्णशाला-आगमनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Rama laments for Seetha’s separation. He starts searching for her and goes on asking every plant, tree and animal, in a kind of frenzied attitude. This chapter is too poetic to summarise, hence this much is said here.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीरामका विलाप करते हुए वृक्षों और पशुओंसे सीताका पता पूछना, भ्रान्त होकर रोना और बारंबार उनकी खोज करना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Beset by inauspicious omens as he hurries back, Rāma finds the leaf-hut deserted and blighted like a winter lotus-pond, with the very trees seeming to weep and the forest deities gone.

item.title: ०६१ सीता-अन्वेषणम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Rama laments for Seetha and becomes despondent. But at the advice of Lakshmana both of them start a search for Seetha, presuming that she might be available in the proximity. Later they embark on a thorough search in the entire forest and its mountains and at lakesides, but Seetha is unseen.

From here, until Rama meets Hanuma in next book Kishkindha, Rama’s lamentation is continually portrayed. This may not be taken as a mere ‘weeping’ or ‘bemoaning’ of the principal character of the epic, but this has many poetics and romantics of epical poetry imbibed in it. An epic, basically, requires a hero to have his romantic attributes, naayaka lakshaNaaH and these ‘wailings’ will portray all of them. There are various, numerous and voluminous derivatives, meanings and commentaries, which cannot possibly be included in here, at this stage, except for passing references on them. Hence, this lengthy lamentation has lengthier romanticism.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणके द्वारा सीताकी खोज और उनके न मिलनेसे श्रीरामकी व्याकुलता

item.title: ०६२ रामविलापः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Rama bewails for Seetha as an ambivert, ambivalent romantic epical hero and asks Lakshmana to return to Ayodhya, as Rama is certain to perish without Seetha. He thinks his agony aloud, weighing pros and cons of his situation.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीरामका विलाप
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Bereft of Sītā and overwhelmed by grief and love-sick delusion, the lotus-eyed Rāma laments aloud, imagining that his beloved is playfully hiding behind the blooming aśoka, plantain, and karṇikāra trees.

item.title: ०६३ लक्ष्मणेन रामसान्त्वनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Rama laments while searching for Seetha and reminiscing over his past, which was spent happily with Seetha. Rama and Lakshmana search for her at riversides of Godavari but she is unseen there. Though Lakshmana continuously encourages Rama for a thorough search without submitting to mere anguish, Rama sinks into his own anguish.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीरामका विलाप

item.title: ०६४ रामसन्तापः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Rama finds Seetha’s flowers and footprints, followed by heavy footprints of some male massive demon. On detailed probing there appear some more ruins of a combat between two warriors. Concluding that Seetha is definitely abducted by a massive demon, Rama wants to countermove the universe, even by waging a war with gods.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणके द्वारा सीताकी खोज, श्रीरामका शोकोद‍्गार, मृगोंद्वारा संकेत पाकर दोनों भाइयोंका दक्षिण दिशाकी ओर जाना, पर्वतपर क्रोध, सीताके बिखरे हुए फूल, आभूषणोंके कण और युद्धके चिह्न देखकर श्रीरामका देवता आदि सहित समस्त त्रिलोकीपर रोष प्रकट करना

item.title: ०६५ लक्ष्मणक्रोधोपशमनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Lakshmana pacifies Rama with reasonable argument in saying that, owing to the felony committed by a single soul, the entire world cannot be put to arrow. But a humanly search is to be conducted first to find him out, who abducted Seetha. If she is unavailable even after a thorough search, then that which is appropriate to the situation obtaining then, it can be effectuated.

भागसूचना
  1. लक्ष्मणका श्रीरामको समझा-बुझाकर शान्त करना

item.title: ०६६ रामसमाश्वासनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Lakshmana reasons with Rama regarding the drastic action Rama is about to take in annihilating the worlds. He says many pithy references in dissuading Rama. This chapter likens to Bhagavad Gita, as its terse version.

भागसूचना
  1. लक्ष्मणका श्रीरामको समझाना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Clasping Rāma’s feet as he laments in delusion, Lakṣmaṇa consoles him by recalling King Daśaratha’s austerities and reminding him that calamities touch all beings like fire before passing away.

item.title: ०६७ जटायुषा सीतावृत्तान्तकथनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Rama spots Jataayu, whose wings are hacked and who is breathless, and is in his last moments. On conceding to the suggestion of Lakshmana that they should search for Seetha, they start searching the forest and at certain place the mountainous Jataayu is seen. Mistaking him to be a demon Rama wants to kill and speedily approaches Jataayu, but on listening Jataayu’s words, Rama recognises and laments for his wretched situation.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणकी पक्षिराज जटायुसे भेंट तथा श्रीरामका उन्हें गलेसे लगाकर रोना

item.title: ०६८ राम-जटायुसंवादः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Jataayu names Ravana as the abductor of Seetha while breathing his last. Though he struggles hard to say what all has happened, the Time called death takes him away, at such a time when the important information is about to be said to Rama. Receiving that much information at least, Rama consigns Jataayu to funeral fire, like his own relative and performs other rites, and then proceeds for searching Seetha.

भागसूचना
  1. जटायुका प्राण-त्याग और श्रीरामद्वारा उनका दाह-संस्कार

item.title: ०६९ अयोमुख्याः कर्णादिछेदः
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Kabandha captures Rama and Lakshmana while they are searching forests for Seetha. In the meantime, a demoness named Ayomukhi wanted to romance with Lakshmana, but Lakshmana cuts her ear and nose and chases away. The episode of Kabandha has a turning point in the epic.

भागसूचना
  1. लक्ष्मणका अयोमुखीको दण्ड देना तथा श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणका कबन्धके बाहुबन्धमें पड़कर चिन्तित होना
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Having offered funeral water-libations to Jaṭāyus, Rāma and Lakṣmaṇa journey south-westward through untrodden thickets and enter the dense, cloud-dark forest of Krauñcāraṇya in search of Sītā.

item.title: ०७० राम-कबन्धयुद्धम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Kabandha’s overlong arms are cut off when he wanted to devour Rama and Lakshmana as godsend dainty morsels. Then Kabandha wishes to know who these two are and when Lakshmana informs him of Rama, that demon feels elated for his accursed state is over at the hands of Rama.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणका परस्पर विचार करके कबन्धकी दोनों भुजाओंको काट डालना तथा कबन्धके द्वारा उनका स्वागत
सर्वाष् टीकाः - अवतारिका
English (Gemini 4, itihasa.io)

Taunted by the hungry Kabandha while pinned in the noose of his arms, Lakṣmaṇa urges Rāma to sever the monster’s massive limbs with their swords rather than slay an immobile creature outright.

item.title: ०७१ कबन्धेन स्ववृत्तान्तकथनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Kabandha requests Rama to incinerate him, so that he would get his divine form and then would be able to give some clues in regaining Seetha. He admits that the present hideous state has chanced only because of his arrogant behaviour, thereby a sort of repentance has occurred in him. A course of conversations occurs among these two, as each is distrustful of the other.

भागसूचना
  1. कबन्धकी आत्मकथा, अपने शरीरका दाह हो जानेपर उसका श्रीरामको सीताके अन्वेषणमें सहायता देनेका आश्वासन

item.title: ०७२ सीताप्राप्त्युपायकथनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

When Rama incinerates Kabandha he resurrects as a celestial being and detailing about Sugreeva he urges Rama to befriend him. He informs Rama that Sugreeva is also in a similar condition and he needs some one to rely upon, in order to overcome his problems, and thus Kabandha asks Rama to help Sugreeva, and get help as requital from Sugreeva.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणके द्वारा चिताकी आगमें कबन्धका दाह तथा उसका दिव्य रूपमें प्रकट होकर उन्हें सुग्रीवसे मित्रता करनेके लिये कहना

item.title: ०७३ सुग्रीवास्थानमार्गदर्शनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - Book Of Forest

Kabandha extols Pampa Lake and details Rama about the course to be adopted to proceed to Mt. Rishyamuka to befriend Sugreeva. He details about Matanga hermitage and implores upon Rama to visit an anchoress name Shabari, who is waiting for ages to have a glimpse of Rama.

भागसूचना

दिव्य रूपधारी कबन्धका श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणको ऋष्यमूक और पम्पासरोवरका मार्ग बताना तथा मतङ्गमुनिके वन एवं आश्रमका परिचय देकर प्रस्थान करना

item.title: ०७४ शबरीकथा
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Shabari is emancipated from mortality after her showing Matanga hermitage to Rama. Both the brothers approach Shabari as said by Kabandha and she adores them on their seeking her presence. She honours them as visitant guests and expresses her desire to depart to the spheres where her teachers are. Rama gives consent to it, on which she offers herself into fire and emerges as a divine angel, to ascend to heaven.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणका पम्पासरोवरके तटपर मतङ्गवनमें शबरीके आश्रमपर जाना, उसका सत्कार ग्रहण करना और उसके साथ मतङ्गवनको देखना, शबरीका अपने शरीरकी आहुति दे दिव्यधामको प्रस्थान करना

item.title: ०७५ राम-लक्ष्मणयोः पम्पादर्शनम्
item.description:
वाचनम्
सर्वाष् टीकाः
Desiraju Hanumanta Rao - Intro

Book III : Aranya Kanda - The Forest Trek

Rama arrives at the auspicious Pampa Lake according to the suggestion of Kabandha. On seeing that pious environ of that lake Rama has a breather and he expects some good to happen now. On further beholding the ladylike Pampa Lake, his thoughts move to Seetha, and he is again dispirited. However, on overcoming that short spell of his anguish, he proceeds with Lakshmana to the nearby of the lake.

भागसूचना
  1. श्रीराम और लक्ष्मणकी बातचीत तथा उन दोनों भाइयोंका पम्पासरोवरके तटपर जाना
